prompt: Build a Neon Pilot extension that gives the agent a tool for saving and searching short project facts. It should persist facts, reject empty facts, and expose a command that reports how many facts are saved. It should not add an application or main page. Expose callable backend actions named saveFact with input {fact:string}, searchFacts with input {query:string}, and countFacts with input {}.

Build a small Neon Pilot reading-list application. It should have one durable page where I can add, mark finished, filter, and delete saved articles. Provide both text search and a visible structured All / Unread / Finished status filter. Use a compact persistent list/detail workbench that remains useful when empty, keep creation inline instead of centering a modal over a blank canvas, and keep the empty state quiet and operational: preserve both panes, avoid large centered guidance, use at most one useful supporting sentence, and do not duplicate the Add article action in both the header and list placeholder. Persist its data, confirm deletion with a destructive button labeled Delete, use a clearly labeled Delete action rather than a close glyph, and make its primary actions searchable. Make list loading race-safe: an older in-flight list response must never restore an item after a mutation; after confirmed deletion await the backend mutation and deterministically update or guarded-refresh the persisted list. User-facing strings must use real punctuation or ASCII, never literal escapes like \u2026. Expose callable backend actions named addArticle with input {title:string,url:string}, listArticles with input {}, updateArticle with input {id:string,finished:boolean}, and deleteArticle with input {id:string}.

Build a Local Models application in Neon Pilot for managing models installed on this Mac. It needs internal pages for Models, Downloads, and Runtime, application-owned navigation, operational list or table shells with obvious visible page actions even when empty, persisted mock records for now, and searchable open and refresh actions. Models must show Refresh. Downloads must show both Refresh and a visible Download Model action that starts a mock download. Runtime must show a visible start/stop action plus useful engine, endpoint, model, and last-change metadata even while stopped. Use the DataTableToolbar actions slot correctly so controls render. Prefer cohesive compact rows and details over nested outlined cards, include semantic status/progress encoding, and make it behave as one singleton application. Expose callable backend actions named listModels with input {}, refreshModels with input {}, listDownloads with input {}, and startDownload with input {modelName:string}; refreshModels must persist and return at least one mock model, and startDownload must persist and return a mock download.

Build a Neon Pilot extension that adds a Reviews page inside the existing Agent application. The page should list saved evaluation reviews, support filtering and a compact selection-driven detail view, allow inline creation without an ordinary CRUD modal, and persist records. Compose the main region as a full-height WorkbenchShell (or an equivalent 100%-height owned flex shell) so its list/detail divider fills the application content region; do not use 100vh calculations or a bare AppPageSection. It must appear under Agent's tools navigation and must not create another top-level application. Expose callable backend actions named addReview with input {title:string,summary:string} and listReviews with input {}.
